parameters.name: DefaultAlgo
parameters.description: Name of the default encryption or masking algorithm

parameters.name: MaskingAlgo
parameters.description: Rule algorithm. Multiple algorithms can be selected. Masking Algorithm can include additional parameters. Format: {name: algorithm1}, {name: algorithm2, params: {encryption position, number of encrypted characters}}

parameters.name: RuleConfig
parameters.description: Rule configuration, in JSON string format, containing matching rules for databases, tables, and columns

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule Name (only one rule name is supported per request)
